summary: Frontend-only testing of the new IDCAP home (Inscrições Abertas list) and the renamed /assistente-administrativo.html page. All 10 requested checks passed: the home has 4 cards, the modal opens once per session, POST /api/track/access fires on the home only, card navigation works with the loader, the assistente page has 7 working PDFs, no external hrefs, the mobile menu works and the termos -> inscricao regression passes.
critical_code_review_comments: On the home, /api/track/access fires on every page load, including reloads in the same session (2 calls seen after 1 reload). This is fine if it is meant to count page views. Visitor de-dup relies on localStorage visitor_id.
The only http(s) strings in both pages are Bootstrap license comments (not links). A static.cloudflareinsights.com beacon script is injected by the preview proxy, not by the source HTML.
seed_data_creation: No inscriptions created. One manual POST /api/track/access with user_agent 'T1-test' (visitor v_t1test), plus several track/access hits from Playwright home visits.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use wait_until=domcontentloaded. The home (/ and /inicio.html) has data-testids card-sead-analista, card-sead-assistente, aviso-importante-modal, aviso-importante-ok, home-loader, mobile-menu-toggle. Modal key: sessionStorage idcap_aviso_modal_shown. /assistente-administrativo.html has pub-* (7 PDFs, target=_blank, all return 200 application/pdf) and home-fazer-inscricao-btn -> /termos.html (termos-aceite-label, termos-checkbox, btn-continuar-termos -> /inscricao.html). The assistente page has no #aviso-modal and no track call. Clicking the analista card (href=#) and searching both stay on /.
